query: WITH AgeGroupedViolations AS (SELECT YEAR(t.gdate_happened) AS year, CASE WHEN FLOOR(DATEDIFF(t.gdate_happened, d.birth_date) / 365.25) < 25 THEN 'under_25' ELSE 'over_25' END AS age_group, t.violator_id, COUNT(*) AS violation_count FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation AS t JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala AS d ON CAST(t.violator_id AS BIGINT) = d.id WHERE t.gdate_happened BETWEEN '2021-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND NOT d.birth_date IS NULL AND d.birth_date > '1900-01-01' AND t.status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid') GROUP BY YEAR(t.gdate_happened), CASE WHEN FLOOR(DATEDIFF(t.gdate_happened, d.birth_date) / 365.25) < 25 THEN 'under_25' ELSE 'over_25' END, t.violator_id), YearlyAverages AS (SELECT year, age_group, SUM(violation_count) AS total_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT violator_id) AS unique_drivers, SUM(violation_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT violator_id) AS avg_violations_per_driver FROM AgeGroupedViolations GROUP BY year, age_group) SELECT year, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END) AS avg_under_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END) AS avg_over_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN unique_drivers END) AS drivers_under_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN unique_drivers END) AS drivers_over_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN total_violations END) AS violations_under_25, MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN total_violations END) AS violations_over_25, ((MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'over_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END) - MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN age_group = 'under_25' THEN avg_violations_per_driver END)) * 100 AS pct_difference FROM YearlyAverages GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 1200
